symptomShortText: Visible sink mark 0.35mm depth on top cosmetic cover rejected by customer inspection

defect.defectText: Sink mark and internal void on cosmetic injection molded surface

causesIshikawa.description: EMP-6201, Shift B - process technician loaded molding parameter program from USB backup
EQ-MOLD01-002 barrel temperature zones 1-4 and hydraulic pressure stability within +/-1.5%
Molding recipe REC-EE50-02 had holding pressure time set to 2.5s instead of validated 5.5s, switching to cooling before the 3.2mm boss gate solidified
Polycarbonate/ABS blend resin lot RES-3390 MFI 18 g/10min and moisture 0.015% verified within spec
Depth dial indicator GA-0190 calibrated and repeatability confirmed
Mold chiller water temperature 45C +/- 2C on both core and cavity sides

fiveWhyChain.question: Why did the customer reject the electronic enclosure top covers?
fiveWhyChain.answer: A noticeable 0.35mm sink mark shadow was visible directly opposite the internal mounting screw boss

fiveWhyChain.question: Why did plastic volumetric shrinkage form a sink mark at the boss?
fiveWhyChain.answer: Molten polymer was sucked back from the thick boss wall section during cooling before gate freeze occurred

fiveWhyChain.question: Why was packing pressure released before gate freeze? (root cause)
fiveWhyChain.answer: An unreleased trial parameter recipe with 2.5s holding time was loaded during mold changeover instead of the locked production recipe
fiveWhyChain.evidenceCitation: Injection machine recipe change audit trail REC-EE50

actions.actionText: Sort 210 units at customer facility and hold 450 finished enclosures in warehouse for visual audit
Restore validated holding pressure duration (5.5s @ 650 bar) and lock controller recipe with password
Connect injection molding machines to central MES recipe server with checksum validation to block unapproved USB parameter loading

fmeaLink.description: Sink mark and cosmetic defect due to insufficient hold packing time

lessonsLearned.whatWorked: Locking recipe with central server checksum eliminated manual parameter tampering
lessonsLearned.whatDidnt: Operators were able to load test USB recipes without supervisor sign-off

isIsNot.isWhereWhenItHappens: Electronic Enclosure EE-50 molded on WC-MOLD-01 on 2026-08-04 after mold setup
isIsNot.isNotWhereWhenItDoesnt: Batches produced prior to 2026-08-04 or running on WC-MOLD-02 with locked recipe card
isIsNot.notes: Sink mark strictly restricted to the thick boss region due to premature hold pressure release
